text:
Alice M.: Quick ask — can someone run a small smoke bench comparing int4 vs fp8 on llm-2-13b-rw1 (8k context)? Need perf numbers + a 1k-sample quality delta on our qset for the PM sync this afternoon. Prefer cold + warm cache runs.

Carlos R.: I can take this. Which exact revision? and do you want cold and warm KV cache separated?

Alice M.: Use llm-2-13b-rw1 (pinned). Please run both cache modes. Promptset: qsets/safety_perf_2026.json (1k). Output to gs://redwood-bench/bench-probe/2387654321/ — thanks.

Priya S.: heads up — last int4 sweep had a small bump in hallucination for long-answer summarization. If possible, include anchors from qa_pairs_anchors.csv for quick precision checks.

Dan V.: I'll reserve a small Dedicated slot on gpu-pool-4 for 2h to avoid noisy-neighbor variance.

deploy-bot: reserve-bot: reserved gpu-pool-4 for 2h (job j-8923) :white_check_mark:

Carlos R.: Starting int4 run now. Command I'm using: ```python -m redwood.bench.run --model llm-2-13b-rw1 --quant int4 --seq_len 8192 --samples 1000 --cache warm --output gs://redwood-bench/bench-probe/2387654321/int4```
Will follow with fp8 run after.

Carlos R.: Quick interim numbers (warm cache, 1k samples): int4 throughput +32% vs fp16 baseline, avg token latency -12ms, p95 latency +18ms, estimated token cost -41%. Quality delta on qset (EM): -0.6% absolute (concentrated on long-answer subset). FP8 run starting now.

Carlos R.: FP8 (warm) finished: throughput +4% vs fp16, p95 latency +6ms, quality delta -0.1% EM.

Alice M.: Can you attach a handful of the failure samples (int4) and a small confusion summary? Also please run a cold-cache int4 to measure tail latency.

Carlos R.: Uploading artifacts: https://redwood-internal/bench/2387654321/artifacts.zip — includes raw logs, sample diffs, perf CSVs. :thumbsup:

Priya S.: quick peek at the artifacts — the -0.6% looks concentrated in long-seq summarization prompts (3 examples with truncated facts). Recommend a targeted re-run on longseq subset and a small temperature sweep [0.2, 0.7] to check sensitivity.

Carlos R.: Will schedule longseq subset + cold-cache int4 + temp sweep. ETA ~90m.

Alice M.: Good. If longseq re-run confirms the drop, we'll gate int4 for Dedicated (keep FP8 as opt-in) and open a ticket for quant-aware calibration. Filing RT-5467 now for follow-up.

Dan V.: noted — slot still reserved until 2h mark, ping me if you need extension.

Priya S.: also dropping a short checklist in the ticket: reproduce, isolate prompt types, run calibration, sanity eval post-calibration.

Alice M.: Thanks everyone — we'll sync results in the PM sync. :rocket:
